text: Which system integration specialists in Brisbane are best for connecting ERP, CRM, MYOB Acumatica, SAP, and Microsoft 365 systems?

sections.text:
The strongest Brisbane-area candidates are **Leverage Technologies, Cloud Factory, OneKloudX, and Momentum Software Solutions**. The best choice depends on whether you need deep SAP expertise, MYOB Acumatica implementation, Microsoft ecosystem integration, or custom API work.

| Specialist | Best fit | Relevant capabilities |
|---|---|---|
| **Leverage Technologies** | Complex ERP/CRM programs involving SAP and MYOB Acumatica | SAP Gold Partner and MYOB Acumatica Platinum Partner, with Brisbane offices; provides ERP implementation, data migration, integrations, CRM integration, and ongoing support.[6][7][10] |
| **Cloud Factory** | Organisations comparing or integrating SAP Business One, MYOB Acumatica, and Microsoft platforms | Implements SAP Business One, MYOB Acumatica, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, and Dynamics 365 Sales, with integrations for CRM, e-commerce, warehouse, EDI, and analytics systems.[4] |
| **OneKloudX** | Multi-system integration and API-led automation | Integrates MYOB Acumatica with CRM, payroll, warehouse, banking, and e-commerce platforms; also supports SAP and Microsoft Dynamics 365 environments and integration tools such as Jitterbit.[1] |
| **Momentum Software Solutions** | MYOB Acumatica-led projects in Queensland | MYOB Acumatica Diamond Partner with a Brisbane-area office; provides implementation, customisation, training, support, and integration-focused ERP consulting.[2] |
| **Bright Labs** | Bespoke CRM–ERP connections and non-standard APIs | Builds custom integrations across SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365, MYOB, Salesforce, HubSpot, websites, mobile apps, and legacy systems.[8] |
| **Rise Accountants Brisbane** | Smaller Brisbane businesses primarily needing MYOB Acumatica | Implements and manages MYOB Acumatica and connects it with payroll, inventory, CRM, and third-party applications.[5] |

### Recommended shortlist

1. **Leverage Technologies** — strongest overall candidate for a SAP + MYOB Acumatica program with formal ERP partnership credentials and Brisbane delivery capability.[6][7]
2. **Cloud Factory** — particularly suitable when Microsoft 365/Dynamics 365, SAP Business One, and MYOB Acumatica are all being considered within one architecture.[4]
3. **OneKloudX** — best suited to a broad integration layer connecting ERP, CRM, finance, payroll, warehouse, and external applications.[1]
4. **Momentum** — a sensible choice when MYOB Acumatica is the central ERP and Queensland-based implementation support is important.[2]
5. **Bright Labs** — worth including when the project requires custom APIs, portals, websites, mobile applications, or legacy-system connectivity.[8]

Before appointing one, ask each provider to demonstrate a comparable integration involving **MYOB Acumatica, SAP, Microsoft 365 or Dynamics 365, and your chosen CRM**. Also confirm whether they will own the integration architecture, identity/security model, data mapping, monitoring, error handling, testing, and post-go-live support.
